title: Magnitude bound for circuit outputs
statement: Let $n$ and $X$ be natural numbers with $2\le X$, let $x\in\mathbb{Z}^n$ satisfy $|x_i|\le X$ for every input coordinate $i$, and let $G$ be any list of arithmetic gates on these inputs. For every node index $j$, the value at that position in the circuit run (taken to be zero when the position is absent) has magnitude at most $X^{2^{|G|}}$, where $|G|$ is the number of gates.
hypotheses_covered: Every input coordinate has magnitude at most $X$
